### Security
- **Web Push delivery no longer reaches the server's own network through a malformed address**
  (completes the 2.81.1 fix). The push library reads a subscription address with an older parser
  than the check before it, and for some unusual characters in the host the two disagreed, so a
  crafted address could pass the check and still be sent to an internal address. A push address
  now has to be a plain host name made of letters, digits, hyphens and dots, as every push service
  hands out, and

This is a smaller release with mainly bugfixes and some improvements to the SQLite backend.

See [Changelog](https://github.com/reclosedev/requests-cache/blob/master/HISTORY.md) for complete release details.

Thanks to everyone who provided bug reports, suggestions, and other feedback!

- **Export connections** (Database menu, the navigator's ⋯, a connection's or folder's context menu, the search box): the chosen connections with their folders, connection types and network profiles in a file that Import connections › TernaryGrid file reads back on another machine. Saved passwords are left out, or included encrypted with a password for the file (Argon2id and XChaCha20-Poly1305, as the vault).

### Changed
- Object pages have a one-line header: the pages (Properties, Data, DDL, Columns, Indexes…) with Back / Forward, Refresh and ⋯ at their right, so the data has more room. The object's name is the tab's title; its full path is the tab's tooltip, its size and row estimate on the Statistics page.

### Fixed
- The light theme no longer shows dark notches at the corners of the tab bar and the page under it.
- Editing a field in the record view looks like editing a grid cell: the selection's colour

- Transactions: Oracle EXPLAIN no longer commits, PostgreSQL metadata errors no longer abort your transaction, and the tools (schema compare apply, restore, maintenance, table designer, data sync) respect read-only connections and pending transactions.
- Passwords stay out of error messages and history (`IDENTIFIED BY`, dollar quoting, Redis and MongoDB passwords); two TernaryGrid windows no longer lose vault changes; imported scheduled tasks come disabled.
- An **icon rail** on the left opens the Database

- The portable archives are roughly half the size. The Windows zip drops from 45.7 MB to about 21 MB and the Linux tarball from 45.1 MB to 40.2 MB by shipping only what the app loads: no software OpenGL fallback, no D3D12 shader compiler, no QML debugger plugins, no Qt translations (the app's own catalogs are compiled in), SQLite as the only SQL driver, and only the Basic Quick Controls style that every QML file imports.
- New app-layer tests cover the live language switch, path deduplication, the recents c

- Behind the scenes: the Windows portable archive is now built and tested by GitHub Actions on every release tag, and it links zlib statically so it runs on machines without the redistributable installed
- PS4 patch lookups had stopped working after a change on the patch database's website. Restored.
